description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Investigation of Peak Wind Loads on Roof-Mounted PV Systems is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Arindam Gan Chowdhury, Florida International University (fiu.edu). This project is looking at the aerodynamic effects of wind loads on roof-mounted photovoltaic (PV) systems. Time histories of pressure and force coefficient data can be used to inform Finite Element Modeling of PV arrays to determine their behavior under the action of wind loads. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-pz1e-t297. Keywords: Wall of Wind, Florida International University, Photovoltaic Systems, Wind Engineering, Peak Pressure Coefficient, Resonance. Published 2022-08-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
